_about: The self-recall count for City College of San Francisco report 28 (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py rows_recall): each row of trial 44739067555 read by eye. Report 28 names curriculum staff, so the trial filed no page (d-ccsf-outline-trial-no-staff-names-s689); the count reads each row's parsed outcomes, its lead and its section headings. Every page prints STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES under the lead "Upon completion of this course, a student will be able to:", then CONTENTS; each filed item reads as one outcome, none is the lead, a heading or course content. ENGL 1B prints the heading and the lead with no outcome before CONTENTS. No page prints an objectives heading. Every page's text sits under the 80,000-character cap and its HTML (641,846 to 659,499 characters) was parsed whole, so the trial parsed what a full read sees. The limit of this count: an outcome the parser dropped inside a block cannot be seen without the page.
